title: `<title>` should not be used in _document.js `<Head>`
text_content:
## Why This Error Occurred

Adding `<title>` in `pages/_document.js` will lead to unexpected results with `next/head` since `_document.js` is only rendered on the initial pre-render.

## Possible Ways to Fix It

Set `<title>` in `pages/_app.js` instead:

```jsx filename="pages/_app.js"
import React from 'react'
import Head from 'next/head'

function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Head>
        <title>My new cool app</title>
      </Head>
      <Component {...pageProps} />
    </>
  )
}

export default MyApp
```

Viewport `meta` tags should not be used in `_document.js` `<Head>`
text_content:
## Why This Error Occurred

Adding `<meta name="viewport" ...>` in `pages/_document.js` will lead to unexpected results since it cannot be deduped.
The viewport tag should be handled by `next/head` in `pages/_app.js`.

## Possible Ways to Fix It

Set your viewport `meta` tag in `pages/_app.js` instead:

```jsx filename="pages/_app.js"
import Head from 'next/head'

function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Head>
        <meta name="viewport" content="viewport-fit=cover" />
      </Head>
      <Component {...pageProps} />
    </>
  )
}

export default MyApp
```
